description: Search the YC company directory, filter it by batch, industry, size, stage, hiring status or founder diversity, or fetch specific companies directly by URL or slug.

batches.description: YC batches, either short codes or full names: S24, W24, F24, SP25, or Summer 2024. Leave empty for every batch. All batches are fetched when you need more than 1,000 companies.
batches.title: Batches

companySlugs.description: Direct YC company slugs, e.g. airbnb, stripe. Use this instead of URLs when you already have slugs.
companySlugs.title: Company slugs

companyUrls.description: Direct YC company profile URLs, e.g. https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb. Each URL is fetched independently of the directory search.
companyUrls.title: Company URLs

directoryUrl.description: Y Combinator directory URL. Paste a pre-filtered URL (e.g. https://www.ycombinator.com/companies?batch=S24&industry=AI) to apply its query-string filters. Defaults to the full directory.
directoryUrl.title: Directory URL

emitErrorRecord.description: When on, a run that matches zero companies pushes one diagnostic record instead of leaving the dataset empty. Upstream failures always fail the run and never produce a success record.
emitErrorRecord.title: Emit an error record when nothing matches

foundedAfterYear.description: Keep companies launched in or after this year. YC's launch timestamp is the numeric field the index supports.
foundedAfterYear.title: Founded after year

foundedBeforeYear.description: Keep companies launched in or before this year.
foundedBeforeYear.title: Founded before year

highlightBlackFounders.description: Keep only companies on YC's official Black-founded companies list. The list is an opt-in page, so absence is not proof of anything.
highlightBlackFounders.title: Black-founded companies

highlightHispanicFounders.description: Keep only companies on YC's official Hispanic and Latino-founded companies list.
highlightHispanicFounders.title: Hispanic / Latino-founded companies

highlightWomenFounders.description: Keep only companies on YC's official women-founded companies list.
highlightWomenFounders.title: Women-founded companies

hiringOnly.description: Keep only companies carrying YC's 'is hiring' badge.
hiringOnly.title: YC hiring badge only

includeJobDetails.description: Fetch every job's own page to add its description, interview process and hiring manager. Adds one request per open job.
includeJobDetails.title: Include job descriptions

includeLaunchPosts.description: Add each company's Launch YC posts, including the full post body.
includeLaunchPosts.title: Include Launch YC posts

includeNews.description: Add the news links listed on each company profile.
includeNews.title: Include news items

includeQa.description: Add the founder Q&A answers published on each company profile.
includeQa.title: Include founder Q&A

includeVideos.description: Add YC library / YouTube videos and app or demo-day videos. Expiring signed video URLs are re-hosted in the run's key-value store so they stay playable.
includeVideos.title: Include videos

industries.description: Exact YC industry values, e.g. B2B, Consumer, Fintech, Healthcare, Industrials. Values are matched against YC's industry facet.
industries.title: Industries

maxConcurrency.description: How many profile / job / founder pages are fetched in parallel. Higher is faster; 8 is a polite default.
maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency

maxItems.description: Maximum number of companies to return. Set 0 to return every match (the directory currently has about 6,400 companies; the actor caps a run at 10,000).
maxItems.title: Maximum companies

nonprofitOnly.description: Keep only companies YC marks as nonprofits.
nonprofitOnly.title: Nonprofits only

onlyWithOpenJobs.description: Keep only companies whose profile actually lists at least one open job. This checks the live job list, not just the badge.
onlyWithOpenJobs.title: Only companies with open jobs

query.description: Free-text search across company names, descriptions and tags. Leave empty to browse the directory by filters only.
query.title: Search query

regions.description: Exact YC region values, e.g. Europe, America / Canada, Remote, Fully Remote. Also accepts a free-text location match.
regions.title: Regions

requireFounderSocial.description: Keep only companies where at least one founder has a LinkedIn, Twitter/X, GitHub or website link.
requireFounderSocial.title: Require a founder social profile

scrapeFounderProfiles.description: Also fetch each founder's directory page for schools, previous roles, previous YC companies and a profile URL. Adds one request per founder.
scrapeFounderProfiles.title: Include founder directory profiles

scrapeFounders.description: Add each company's founders (name, title, bio, social links) from its profile page.
scrapeFounders.title: Include founders

scrapeOpenJobs.description: Add each company's complete open-job list from its profile page.
scrapeOpenJobs.title: Include open jobs

sortBy.description: Order in which companies are returned. launchDateDesc, the default, returns the newest launches first.
sortBy.title: Sort order

stages.description: Funding stage: Early or Growth. YC's index does not expose stage as a facet, so this filter is applied to each fetched record.
stages.title: Stages

statuses.description: Company operating status: Active, Inactive, Acquired, Public. Leave empty for all statuses.
statuses.title: Statuses

subIndustries.description: Exact or leaf sub-industry values, e.g. Infrastructure, Productivity, or 'Consumer -> Travel, Leisure and Tourism'.
subIndustries.title: Sub-industries

tags.description: Exact YC tags, e.g. AI, B2B, SaaS, Fintech, Developer Tools. Any one match is enough.
tags.title: Tags

teamSizeMax.description: Drop companies with more employees than this. Uses YC's numeric team-size field.
teamSizeMax.title: Maximum team size

teamSizeMin.description: Drop companies with fewer employees than this. Uses YC's numeric team-size field.
teamSizeMin.title: Minimum team size

topCompaniesOnly.description: Keep only companies YC marks as top companies.
topCompaniesOnly.title: YC top companies only

title: Y Combinator Scraper Pro Input
